title: Add native Control operations pack
summary: Extend the native HumbleStudio Control readiness bridge with the ten accepted operations slices: launcher health, server discovery, app workspace switching, file recovery for app lanes, preview diff artifacts, structured edit drafts, real .humble ticket/lane preflight, safe apply wizard, visual smoke checklist, and smaller native bridge modules.
acceptance_criteria: The native Control readiness workspace exposes launcher health and can prefer a local HumbleControl.app launch before falling back to the Control URL.
Server discovery shows live runtime state, manifest candidates, and localhost endpoint attempts.
The workspace includes a native switcher for the accepted ten app lanes and keeps HumbleSudoku local-first loading available.
All ten app lanes expose file recovery state with local export, generator, remote, or missing-source status.
Preview diff artifacts, structured draft inbox, ticket/lane preflight, safe apply wizard, and visual smoke status are visible without enabling source writes.
Ticket/lane preflight reads the real .humble ticket store, lane registry, and status snapshot.
The large Control readiness implementation is split into smaller native bridge support and view modules.
Native build and repository checks prove the operations pack compiles and preserves the locked no-write contract.

evidence.note: The native Control readiness grid now mounts nine new operations sections before the previous readiness details.
Bridge runtime, snapshot, file recovery, manifest discovery, .humble repo preflight, and launcher actions are split into a support module.
Launcher health, server discovery, app switcher, file recovery, diff artifacts, structured draft inbox, preflight, safe apply, and visual smoke views are native SwiftUI sections.
Launcher action prefers a local HumbleControl.app when available and falls back to the selected Control workspace URL.
Server discovery reports live runtime state, local manifest candidates, and all configured localhost origins.
The .humble preflight reads the real ticket store, HS-0106 ticket, lane registry, and status snapshot instead of placeholder state.
Preview diff, structured drafts, safe apply, and visual smoke keep writes:false, sourceWrites:false, and source apply locked.
Non-ASCII scan returned no matches for the updated Swift sources.
python3 Scripts/check_web_fallback.py passed: web fallback ok.
xcodebuild -project HumbleStudio.xcodeproj -scheme HumbleStudioMac -configuration Debug build passed: BUILD SUCCEEDED.
Read-only file probe found the HumbleSudoku local export present.
Local curl probes to ports 3035, 3022, and 3000 found no running Control server, so fallback discovery is the truthful runtime state.
python3 Scripts/humble_doctor.py --repo-root . --strict reported the expected branch-freshness failure for the active HS-0106 topic lane before promotion.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to implement all ten next HumbleStudio and HumbleControl bridge steps.
trigger.note: This remains a native review/control surface. Source apply stays locked until a separate accepted write contract exists.
